embeds.description:
⚠️ A Kind, but Firm, Reminder from the Lair Bear Family ⚠️

Our Discord is a place of warmth, kindness, and support. We welcome all who come here in good faith to share in that spirit.

That said, please be aware: unsolicited offers of art services, graphic design, stream management, or similar services are __NOT__ welcome here.
They are unneeded, unwanted, and will not be tolerated. We have several family members who are creative and, when asked nicely, will perform these services for family members for free. We don't need anyone soliciting these services for money.

We ask that all who enter respect this boundary. We are a family first and foremost—__not a marketplace__. Anyone who disregards this will be removed from our den, no matter how kindly we try to live together.


__1st Occurrence:__ Message deleted, Booted from Server & Banned

__Unsolicited Direct DM Offense - Auto-Booted from Server & Banned__
(The above is a form of harassment and definitely __not__ tolerated.)

Thank you for understanding, and for keeping our space safe, supportive, and focused on what truly matters—our Lair Bear Family.

__**Guideline #6:**__ Do NOT perpetuate drama, please?! Goodness knows we all have enough stress in our lives already. If you have an issue with someone, take it to DMs like the adults you are and work it out. If that doesn’t work, bring it to the ModBears or even ME to look into/work with you both on. If, in the end, this cannot be worked out between the two parties involved, the ModBears may be forced to decide based on the information provided to them by both parties which may result in one or both parties being booted and (possibly) banned from the Sleuth. Sometimes we have to put on our Adult pants and make decisions we don’t like. Do not post screenshots to or from other servers for the sake of gossip and drama.
__**Guideline #8:**__ While we encourage you to share information about your life, please refrain from anything that could be highly triggering. If you need to post a spoiler/minor trigger, please use || surrounding the message. PLEASE, do not post other people’s private information without their consent. I mean, this is common sense, folks. 
***All*** warnings and bans will be applied by the ModBears or Me according to the following scale and number of offences committed:


__1st Warning:__ Spoken to
__2nd Warning:__ Spoken to and Muted for 1 Day
__3rd Warning:__ Spoken to and then Muted for 7 Days
__FINAL Warning:__ Booted from Server and Banned

__***WARNING:***__ ALL RULES ARE SUBJECT TO COMMON SENSE AND MAY CHANGE AS NEEDED.

__**Guideline #1:**__ This discord is in English (please and thank you). Mama Bear Xal only speaks English fluently. And sometimes not all that well. She is, however, fluent in Typonese and can read, write, and speak it. Though Mama Bear does, in fact, like learning about other languages, let’s keep the chat in the Sleuth in English as much as BEARILY possible, please.
__**Guideline #2:**__ Respect each other. We're all human (er, bears), we’re all individuals, we all have our own identities (some of us multiple) and we all deserve respect. This is the most important guideline in this Sleuth – both here and on Twitch. …except spiders. Spiders can die in a fiery inferno. If anything that is being discussed is making you uncomfortable, or someone is making you feel uncomfortable, please let Me (@Mama) or a Moderator Bear (@ModBear) know. We can't help if we don't know about it. We want this to be a fun and enjoyable place to hang out.
__**Guideline #3:**__ This Sleuth is for the most part 18+ since my Twitch is, but please pay attention to the channel you are posting in, and in what area. If it says Palia Screenshots and ya post your grandma’s chili recipe there? It’s probably gonna get deleted. The NSFW (Not Safe For Work) channels are strictly 18+ with no exceptions. You should confirm what channel you are posting in before you post. While mistakes can happen, repeated violation of this rule will resort in a warning. If the behavior continues, further action, up to and including booting from the server, will be taken. ModBears are at liberty to delete anything that doesn’t adhere to the channel’s content or rating.
__**Guideline #4:**__ Absolutely NO hate, sexism, racism, gender bashing, or super controversial topics. You wanna talk about religion or politics? Take it to private/direct messages (PMs/DMs), we really don’t need it here, please? It can ruin too many friendships. I’ve seen it happen.
__**Guideline #5:**__ Do **NOT** post any sort of shock content (including excessive blood, gore, etc.), pornog...

Like my Twitch Channel, THIS CHAT IS 14+ - HOWEVER - It also contains ADULT Content, ADULT Language, and ADULT Humor. By agreeing to this message and the following chat rules and continuing into the Discord Server, you are *agreeing that you have parental consent to be in a channel with ADULT THEMES in it*! By doing so, you are removing any and all liability from my hands as you have been warned of the content of this Discord Server and still joined. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.

embeds.title: Welcome to the Mama Bear's Lair
embeds.description:
After certain recent events involving some friends and acquaintances in and of the Lair Bear Family, I'd like to say something about one of the *primary* rules of this space.  **This is a safe space for __ALL__.** This includes people of all genders.  Gender identity and preferred pronouns __will__ be respected for all people at all times.  This applies to everyone. There may be people we disagree with, dislike, and even people who we think may have slighted us in some way, intentionally or unintentionally but, respect for every person's gender identity and pronouns is unconditional.
     Just as I have a name as my identity and you respect me by calling me by that, I also have preferred pronouns (she/her) that you call me by out of respect. I expect this to be no different for __*anyone*__ in this Family.
     Now, I do understand there will be the occasional slip up from time to time, however, to repeatedly make the mistake begins to seem intentional and hurtful. This won’t be tolerated and will fall under a bit more ***strict*** Warning Policy than the one in the rules because of the damage it can do to someone’s mental health.
- __1st Warning:__ Spoken to and given the correct Pronouns to use
- __2nd Warning:__ Spoken to, given the correct Pronouns again, then Muted for 7 Days
- __FINAL Warning:__ Booted from the Server and Banned
     I do hope you can understand the lengths I must go to to protect my Family and their mental health. I am tolerant - but only to a point. **ZERO** tolerance is reserved for those who I __know__ should know better and do it anyway. And you know I know who you are, too. We do have bears in this lair with other mental health issues that need a little extra guidance on some things before it catches on completely. Which is why I’m being a *little* tolerant on this issue. I, myself, have had to adjust from he/him to they/them for @nonbinarycatdad after almost 22 years together and it’s taking time. I understand mistakes happen.
     Just don’t let me catch you mis-gende...

embeds.title: ***Welcome to Mama Bear's Lair on Discord!***
embeds.description:
Hello and a warm welcome to all of my New MemBEARS!  👋 I'm thrilled to have you join my Sleuth here on Discord! ❤️

🤝  Please, take some time to introduce yourself to The Sleuth (yes, a group or collection of bears is called a sleuth) – share a bit about yourself, your interests, and what brings you here! Well, besides your love of gaming and/or Mama Bear Xal, that is. 

📜 Before you dive in, __please__ take a moment to read through the server rules. We, well, that is, Itty Bitty Bear and I, want everyone to have a *great* time here, and following the guidelines helps create a positive, fun environment for everyone.

We're excited to have you here, and we can't wait to get to know you better. Enjoy your stay!   🐻  🍯  🧡
